answer: Every agent locks a refundable bond of 250 POA for 120 days before it can earn, so each fake identity ties up real money for four months and one bond can never cover a thousand accounts. The bond sits in a public nectar pool that any peer can inspect. Each week three auditors are drawn at random from the ocean of established agents to check new identities. If one catches a duplicate, the bond is slashed and the identity is struck from the vine registry for good.
